reviews.title: Obsessed! Necessity for multiple caregivers
reviews.text:
i absolutely love this app!!! it’s been a complete game changer for managing my dog’s care, especially since because i work long hours & she has a daily routine, i have multiple walkers and sitters rotating. having one shared place where everyone can see when she last ate, went potty, or had a walk makes everything so smooth. whoever is with her always knows what to expect just by looking at her previous logged events without needing to text or guess, which takes so much stress off of me. i also love the reminder system; being able to set reminders for everyone or only specific people is super helpful, and the fact that each person can choose to turn off notifications on their end is perfect for walkers who don’t need constant alerts. the customization and analytics are another huge plus, i love being able to track patterns and stay on top of her routine. and the fact that you can log events while a walk is still in progress without stopping the timer is such a thoughtful feature!

my only wish is that the app supported video uploads, but aside from that, it’s honestly amazing and exactly what i needed.

reviews.title: Not loving it
reviews.text: So I downloaded this app and you get most of the functionality free, which is great. You don’t have access to a calendar or reports unless you subscribe. I subscribed for one month and so far I’m not impressed. I set scheduled reminders to start in April- when we get a new puppy. However, I’m already getting those reminders today. You can’t set a reminder for multiple pets. I have to set a reminder for each dog individually and each cat individually or just pick one of them and pretend it’s all of them. I can’t just say “feed dogs” or “feed pet A, B and C”. Also the reminders are just that, reminders. They aren’t tasks. There’s no checkbox for you to click once it’s done. You have to go and manually create an event saying “I fed dogs A, B and C” as an event. It’s nice that it’s a shared app across multiple users. So if my husband goes in and creates an event saying he fed the dogs then I know not to feed them. But I also know he’s not going to want to do more than a check box. So it is limiting. Will update if anything changes.

A few suggestions we’d make are: ability to choose light or dark mode instead of it automatically changing, seeing how long it has been since the event was logged (i.e. 3 min. ago, 2 hrs ago, etc.) on the activity page underneath the time it was charted, the ability to add a note to the activity page without it being attached to an event, and having the analytics page provide more useful information. reviews.title: Pretty good! Some improvements needed
reviews.text:
So far this app is the closest I’ve found to what I’m looking for! I was not looking for an app with features like shopping for dog products, searching for groomers, etc. I just wanted a way to accurately log and track my dog’s vaccinations, medical records, food rotations, etc. This app is great for that! While it’s fairly basic, it does what I need it to and it’s not glitchy. For it being a free app, I’m very happy with it so far. I especially enjoy the reminders for logging when a vaccine is due, adding family members so my boyfriend is kept in the loop, and the option to filter for certain “events” on your timeline. The filter feature came in handy recently when I filtered for an event category I created called “Symptoms” and was able to see exactly when my dog started showing symptoms of a possible eye infection to share those details with the vet. Still, I do have a few suggestions for the developers that I think would improve the user experience. 

1. Ability to reorder the fields in the pet’s profile (such as by holding them down to reorder, or by giving the option to move a field up or down in the order). Ex: I added my dog’s vet info, doggy daycare info, microchip #, and then realized I should add the vet’s phone number as a field too. I was unable to move the new vet phone # field up with the rest of the vet info and had to delete my other fields and re-enter them after the phone number to group the vet info together. 

2. Ability to click “Return” to enter to a new line within the typing box in the “Add a field” section. Right now, clicking “Return” on the keyboard saves the field and there is no way to click enter to add info on a new line within the same field. 

3. Ability to upload pictures to an event. I recently tracked some symptoms on my dog over a few days that I thought could indicate the beginning of an eye infection. It would be nice to be able to upload pictures with each event to track the changes. 

4. Exporting the data as a user-friendly PDF. As of now, when you export the data from your account, it is formatted as text only (no organization, difficult to decipher, and looks like something out of a coding textbook). It would be super helpful if the app developers created a PDF layout that inputs all of your pet’s profile info, events, and progress pictures in an organized format when exporting the information. That way a copy could be emailed or printed to give the vet so they can get accurate information. I currently give my vet an updated print out at each visit listing my dog’s food, treats, toppers/supplements and symptoms dated in chronological order, so being able to export that data would save me a TON of time! I would pay for a “premium” version of the app to be able to export my dog’s info in this way.

Super practical.
